prerequisites: Knowledge in handling C or C++ as acquired in the first two semesters of computer science study programs (alternatively: Rust).

learning_outcomes.text: Students know and understand essential components of operating systems. They can explain and evaluate the functionality of these elements and apply them in the context of energy-efficient virtualized environments.
Students have more precise knowledge of system interfaces for processes and for accessing distributed system resources.
Students are able to reflect on operating system concepts when realizing applications and services with regard to their use.
Students can select suitable system interfaces for applications and services and use these interfaces in a structured manner.
Students are able to create operating system-related software for specific applications and to communicate and demonstrate its use.

syllabus_topics: Tasks, types and structure of operating systems
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam. An ungraded experimental work, consisting of approximately 8 experiments, is also required. Refer to the current study regulations for exam duration and scope.
